tasks.objective: Predict the subcellular location of this protein. Use the original DeepLoc/ProtST class IDs and descriptions below. Return only one integer class ID from 0 through 9.
tasks.target_definition: Original ten-compartment DeepLoc curated localization class; integer mapping from pinned official ProtST subloc_language.tsv, independently of test labels.
tasks.split_caveat: Actual publisher-MD5-matched test LMDB has2773 rows; loader docstring2768 is stale. Pinned load_lmdbs/load_sequence performs no row filtering.
tasks.input_interface: Complete amino-acid sequence and fixed objective; native class ontology additionally supplied for P03
tasks.good_score_establishes: Outcome agreement on this released test under the fixed zero-shot full-sequence protocol
tasks.bad_score_establishes: Limited outcome recovery in this representation/regime; not an isolated measure of general reasoning
tasks.mechanism_reference: not evaluated; correct prediction does not certify explanation
tasks.regime_comparison: New prompted zero-shot Qwen baseline; native-trained TAPE/ProtST heads are a different training regime. Same released data/metric is not full historical-paper reproduction.

tasks.objective: Predict the continuous protein-folding stability score of this sequence on the original TAPE/Rocklin experimental scale (the stability_score target), which measures resistance to unfolding under the source assay. Return only one finite numerical value.
tasks.target_definition: Source TAPE stability_score[0], an experimental proxy for intrinsic folding stability under the source concentration-threshold assay. The released numerical scale is preserved without conversion.
tasks.units: native TAPE stability_score scale; no conversion to melting temperature or energy
